text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync notes from design review — compact scorecard approval flow. Found a few UX/a11y frictions when approving runs in dense mode: focus behavior, success feedback, and CTA copy need fixes.

Samir Patel: I can repro. Opening approve modal focuses first checkbox in the list, not the dialog. Screen reader reads background content.

Jia Li: Likely missing proper role=dialog and focus trap. Suggested tab order: header (close) -> primary CTA (Approve) -> reason input -> examples list -> secondary actions. Add a visible focus ring for dense styles.

Oliver Grant: Copy question: current CTA is `Approve results`. Do we prefer `Approve run` or `Approve all`? Which matches user mental model?

Nina (Design): I like `Approve run` since it's scoped, but we should add helper text: `Approves all examples in this run.` to avoid ambiguity with per-example approvals.

Leo (Product): Short label wins in compact layout. `Approve run` + helper line beneath CTA works.

Jia Li: Accessibility checklist: add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" on modal root, focus the container with tabindex=-1 on open, and use aria-live="polite" for the approval confirmation. Toast should announce `Run approved — 24 examples` and include a keyboard-focusable `Undo`.

Maya Chen: Interaction nit: current flow closes modal immediately, shows toast, then page refreshes. Easy to miss. Proposal: keep modal open and swap to a success state (green header + inline undo) for 4-6s, then auto-close. Makes Undo discoverable and reduces context jump.

Samir Patel: Technically straightforward. We'll swap body to success panel, add subtle green outline to approved rows, and include data-qa attributes for e2e. Also block Escape from closing until undo timer expires to avoid accidental dismiss.

Nina (Design): Mobile constraints — inline Undo next to CTA will crowd. For narrow widths show `Undo` as a text link under the CTA and ensure 48px tappable targets.

ux-bot: Accessibility check failed on staging: modal missing role=dialog and aria-modal=true. Issue #1123 created.

Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Samir: implement focus trap, role attributes, success-state + undo timer, data-qa hooks (due Mon). 2) Jia: prepare two copy variants for quick A/B: A=`Approve run`, B=`Approve all` + helper line (due Tue). 3) Nina: mock success state + mobile layout with undo link (due Wed). I'll loop back for a quick proto review once PR lands.

Samir Patel: noted, will open a staging PR with fixes and QA hooks.

Jia Li: I'll add copy options and the a11y notes into the doc.

Oliver Grant: OK to ship `Approve run` by default unless testing shows confusion.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — adding a short follow-up thread when PR is ready :spiral_note_pad:.

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:

Nina (Design): :ok_hand:

Leo (Product): thanks!
